game.title: LittleBigPlanet 3
game.blurb: Side-scrolling puzzle platformer and level-creation game set in the world of Bunkum, from Sumo Digital, published by Sony Computer Entertainment, released 2014-11-18 on PlayStation 3 and PlayStation 4. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Adventure, Puzzle, Platformer. Chapters are broad and drawn from the RAWG description and the trophy themes RAWG lists.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). PlayStation 3 and PlayStation 4 only, so there is no Steam app; RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3501), and its store list has only the PlayStation Store. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a perfect stub): only the main page and a short Table of Contents are written; Controls, Gameplay, Trophies and Walkthrough are linked but not written, and no level page names exist, so swNames was not used. littlebigplanet.fandom.com answers the API under "LittleBigPlanet 3" with 45 linked articles (including "List of LittleBigPlanet 3 levels" and "LittleBigPlanet 3 Story"); names only were looked at, nothing copied, and no level order was taken from it. The chapters are broad and come from the RAWG description (Bunkum, the three heroes, Newton, creating and sharing) and the 38 trophies RAWG lists (RAWG's percentages; RAWG's detail reports 304 achievements in total, which does not match its 38-item list). "The Journey Home" is named in three RAWG trophies; what it is beyond that is not in the data.
